subject.title: lossless-claw bootstraps into quarantine after every Gateway restart due to new sessionId generating fresh JSONL file

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as the opt-in contract for preserving aborted session ids across controlled Gateway restarts?
rationale: The source-level gap is real enough to keep tracking, but the proposed fix adds a compatibility-sensitive session config surface and changes session-state reuse semantics.

options.title: Sponsor the linked opt-in PR
options.body: Proceed with reviewing and landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567 if maintainers accept this narrow Gateway restart continuity contract.

options.title: Require broader restart recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open but redirect the fix toward the broader restart recovery design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57425.

options.title: Decline core continuation
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR if maintainers decide OpenClaw should not preserve aborted session ids across restarts for this LCM workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked opt-in PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with reviewing and landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567 if maintainers accept this narrow Gateway restart continuity contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the terminal-main transcript reconciliation behavior that the proposed fix modifies and have adjacent session transcript history in the same path.
